name: tts-experimental-py
description: OPT-IN experimental text-to-speech for model families the default Rust tts-rs module does not support (XTTS, Kokoro, F5, MeloTTS, Chatterbox, MMS, etc.). Requires a working Python environment (pip packages are auto-installed on first run). Start it manually from the modules window; not auto-started by default.
